review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares one structure, LocalKaehlerField, and four defs: connection, curvature, logDet and ricciHessian. All five are specific to Kähler geometry on Fin n → ℂ, using the project's own Wirtinger operators (mderiv, dz, dzbar). I searched the repo for the helper definitions V, e, mderiv, wderiv and potentialMatrix. These are project-local, and the target file does not define them. I did not find a Mathlib structure that bundles a local Kähler metric, Chern connection, curvature or Ricci Hessian. Mathlib has no Kähler-manifold API. logDet is just Real.log of the real part of the determinant, composed from existing operations. The Mathlib pieces used (Matrix.PosDef, fderiv, ContDiffOn, Matrix inverse and det) are reused rather than redefined. I found no avoidable competing version of an existing Mathlib concept in this file. I did not check duplicates elsewhere in the repo, because the rubric is about Mathlib, Lean core and Batteries.
